title: "Recommendation Systems Showcase"

## Project

Content-based and collaborative music recommendation demonstrations.

This GitHub Pages site contains static documentation. The interactive Python application runs separately on Streamlit Community Cloud.

## Use the project

- [Source repository](https://github.com/nhamhhung/recommendation-showcase)
- [Interactive Streamlit app](https://recommendation-showcase.streamlit.app)
- [Clone, fork, and deployment guide](https://github.com/nhamhhung/recommendation-showcase/blob/main/docs/SETUP_AND_DEPLOYMENT.md)

## Reproduce it

Clone the repository, create a Python 3.11 or 3.12 environment, install `requirements.txt` and `app/requirements.txt`, run `pytest tests/`, then run `python scripts/smoke_app.py`.

Open all eight content-based and collaborative views; complete one recommendation and one collaborative prediction.
